variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: realistic fantasy game weapon modular pommel design reference for user approval, not a finished game asset.
Input images: Image 1 is the EXISTING Rune Longsword, used ONLY for host identity, scale relationships and metalwork style. Image 2 is its EXISTING stock pommel, used for its upper mounting neck and etched-silver design language. Image 3 is the EXISTING grip, used ONLY to understand the mating connection. Do not reproduce the whole sword or the grip.
Create ONE landscape three-view design sheet of ONE new detachable sword pommel, with precisely consistent geometry across the three views. Arrange front orthographic on left, exact 90-degree side orthographic in center, axial bottom orthographic on right. Left and center upright with the mating neck at the top and striking end at the bottom. Equal scale, generous clean spacing, high-resolution fine detail.
The upper mounting neck retains the compact stepped flared silver collar and flat mating surface of the stock reference; transition continuously into the new body below. This is a small end-cap for a two-handed sword, roughly the original pommel's overall scale; no full mace, no weapon handle, no oversized club head.
Use physically credible etched silver / aged steel surfaces, restrained wear, fine rune-like incised ornaments related to the existing sword, readable clean edges and realistic PBR concept rendering with soft neutral studio lighting.
Backdrop: completely plain white, objects isolated without ground plane, without drop shadows, without pedestals. No text, no labels, no arrows, no dimensions, no UI, no watermark, no scenery. Do not include any stats or numbers in the image. No exploded views, no extra variants. Orthographic reference, not dramatic perspective.
Primary request: design 陨星锤首 (Meteor Pommel). Heavy impact-focused variant. A compact dense meteoric-steel head with a broad blunt flattened octagonal striking end, thick beveled shoulders, six to eight integrated longitudinal reinforcement ridges, and a dark iron central mass framed by the sword's etched silver metalwork. Its silhouette is weighted and solid, slightly broader than stock but still a practical sword pommel. A shallow eight-point star engraved in the bottom impact face, with just a tiny cool-blue inset at its center. No luminous cracks, no loose rocks, no spikes. Show solid continuous load-bearing metal from collar to impact surface. Identity: weight, physical impact, knockback. The gameplay brief is quick-melee damage multiplier +0.25 and knockback distance +50%; communicate weight visually without printing these stats.

Primary request: design 疾星配重 (Swiftstar Counterweight). Speed-focused lightweight variant. A slender tapering silver-steel spindle, noticeably narrower and less bulky than the stock rounded pommel, with three swept recessed channels and two large, clean, symmetric lengthwise weight-reduction openings through its flanks. A continuous solid central spine and a small rounded blunt end-cap keep it mechanically connected and practical. Compact architectural flowing edges echo a shooting star through metal shape alone, no actual trails. Thin engraved blue-gray rune accents recessed into the load-bearing spine, no dominant jewel. Restrained silver surfaces with darker inset cavities; openings must be clearly distinguishable from black paint and consistent in front, side and bottom views. The upper collar and connection remain the stock size, then taper smoothly to the narrow body. No razor blades near the user's hand, no long spikes, no giant star ornament. Identity: rapid handling at the cost of heavy charged blows. The gameplay brief is attack speed +15% and charged-heavy damage multiplier -0.25; do not print these stats.
